rv.q: Mac seems miscast at first — he’s not physically commanding — but he brings warmth to the role of the master of the universe who finally discovers his soul. Both leads are fine singers, although it is Rachael Wooding as Vivian’s pal Kit, who blows the roof off on a paean to the high life, Rodeo Drive .
This aggressively stupid musical version of the Julia Roberts smash justifies the terrible Broadway reviews
Everything is tighter, more relaxed and polished.

cn.t: Critics are sharply divided on this musical adaptation, with some celebrating its crowd-pleasing entertainment value while others dismiss it as witless and dated, questioning whether the story translates successfully to the stage.
